# module: buf
# case:   base
# vars:
#   AGAINST=BASE-AGAINST
#   BUF_FMT_SKIP_PATTERN=BASE-BUF_FMT_SKIP_PATTERN
#   BUF_LINT_SKIP_PATTERN=BASE-BUF_LINT_SKIP_PATTERN
#   BUF_VERSION=BASE-BUF_VERSION
#   CONFIG=BASE-CONFIG
#   EXTRA_ARGS=BASE-EXTRA_ARGS
#   INPUT=BASE-INPUT

=== task: breaking ===

    "$input" \
    BASE-EXTRA_ARGS
  "$input" \
  BASE-EXTRA_ARGS
  buf breaking --against "BASE-AGAINST" \
  exit
  filter "SKIPFILES_PATTERN=$skip_pattern" SKIPFILES_MATCHING=true |
  find "$scan_input" -type f -name '*.proto' -print0
  printf '%s\000' "$scan_input"
  set -- "$@" --exclude-path "$path"
  tr '\0' '
' >"$matched_files"
buf breaking "$@" --against "BASE-AGAINST" \
done <"$matched_files"
elif [ -f "$scan_input" ]; then
fi
fi | task --silent --taskfile "$REPO/taskfiles/buf/../internal/skipfiles/Taskfile.yml" \
if [ -d "$scan_input" ]; then
if [ -n "" ]; then scan_input=.; fi
if [ -z "$skip_pattern" ]; then
matched_files="$(mktemp)"
scan_input="$input"
set --
skip_pattern='BASE-BUF_LINT_SKIP_PATTERN'
task: "_buf:unix" finished
task: "_buf:unix" started
task: "_buf:windows" not for current platform - ignored
task: "_install:linux" not for current platform - ignored
task: "_install:macos" finished
task: "_install:macos" started
task: "_install:windows" not for current platform - ignored
task: "breaking" finished
task: "breaking" started
task: "install" finished
task: "install" started
task: [_buf:unix] input='BASE-INPUT'
task: [_install:macos] brew install bufbuild/buf/buf
task: [_install:macos] echo 'Buf installed.'
task: [_install:macos] echo 'Installing Buf via Homebrew...'
task: [breaking] echo "✅ buf breaking check passed"
task: status command command -v buf >/dev/null 2>&1 && buf --version | grep -Fqx "BASE-BUF_VERSION" exited non-zero: exit status 1
trap 'rm -f "$matched_files"' EXIT
while IFS= read -r path; do

=== task: fmt ===

    "$input" \
    BASE-EXTRA_ARGS
  "$input" \
  BASE-EXTRA_ARGS
  buf format --write  \
  exit
  filter "SKIPFILES_PATTERN=$skip_pattern" SKIPFILES_MATCHING=true |
  find "$scan_input" -type f -name '*.proto' -print0
  printf '%s\000' "$scan_input"
  set -- "$@" --exclude-path "$path"
  tr '\0' '
' >"$matched_files"
buf format --write "$@"  \
done <"$matched_files"
elif [ -f "$scan_input" ]; then
fi
fi | task --silent --taskfile "$REPO/taskfiles/buf/../internal/skipfiles/Taskfile.yml" \
if [ -d "$scan_input" ]; then
if [ -n "" ]; then scan_input=.; fi
if [ -z "$skip_pattern" ]; then
matched_files="$(mktemp)"
scan_input="$input"
set --
skip_pattern='BASE-BUF_FMT_SKIP_PATTERN'
task: "_buf:unix" finished
task: "_buf:unix" started
task: "_buf:windows" not for current platform - ignored
task: "_install:linux" not for current platform - ignored
task: "_install:macos" finished
task: "_install:macos" started
task: "_install:windows" not for current platform - ignored
task: "fmt" finished
task: "fmt" started
task: "install" finished
task: "install" started
task: [_buf:unix] input='BASE-INPUT'
task: [_install:macos] brew install bufbuild/buf/buf
task: [_install:macos] echo 'Buf installed.'
task: [_install:macos] echo 'Installing Buf via Homebrew...'
task: status command command -v buf >/dev/null 2>&1 && buf --version | grep -Fqx "BASE-BUF_VERSION" exited non-zero: exit status 1
trap 'rm -f "$matched_files"' EXIT
while IFS= read -r path; do

=== task: fmt:check ===

    "$input" \
    BASE-EXTRA_ARGS
  "$input" \
  BASE-EXTRA_ARGS
  buf format --diff  \
  exit
  filter "SKIPFILES_PATTERN=$skip_pattern" SKIPFILES_MATCHING=true |
  find "$scan_input" -type f -name '*.proto' -print0
  printf '%s\000' "$scan_input"
  set -- "$@" --exclude-path "$path"
  tr '\0' '
' >"$matched_files"
buf format --diff "$@"  \
done <"$matched_files"
elif [ -f "$scan_input" ]; then
fi
fi | task --silent --taskfile "$REPO/taskfiles/buf/../internal/skipfiles/Taskfile.yml" \
if [ -d "$scan_input" ]; then
if [ -n "" ]; then scan_input=.; fi
if [ -z "$skip_pattern" ]; then
matched_files="$(mktemp)"
scan_input="$input"
set --
skip_pattern='BASE-BUF_FMT_SKIP_PATTERN'
task: "_buf:unix" finished
task: "_buf:unix" started
task: "_buf:windows" not for current platform - ignored
task: "_install:linux" not for current platform - ignored
task: "_install:macos" finished
task: "_install:macos" started
task: "_install:windows" not for current platform - ignored
task: "fmt:check" finished
task: "fmt:check" started
task: "install" finished
task: "install" started
task: [_buf:unix] input='BASE-INPUT'
task: [_install:macos] brew install bufbuild/buf/buf
task: [_install:macos] echo 'Buf installed.'
task: [_install:macos] echo 'Installing Buf via Homebrew...'
task: [fmt:check] echo "✅ buf format check passed"
task: status command command -v buf >/dev/null 2>&1 && buf --version | grep -Fqx "BASE-BUF_VERSION" exited non-zero: exit status 1
trap 'rm -f "$matched_files"' EXIT
while IFS= read -r path; do

=== task: generate ===
task: "_install:linux" not for current platform - ignored
task: "_install:macos" finished
task: "_install:macos" started
task: "_install:windows" not for current platform - ignored
task: "generate" finished
task: "generate" started
task: "install" finished
task: "install" started
task: [_install:macos] brew install bufbuild/buf/buf
task: [_install:macos] echo 'Buf installed.'
task: [_install:macos] echo 'Installing Buf via Homebrew...'
task: [generate] buf generate  "BASE-INPUT" BASE-EXTRA_ARGS && echo "✅ buf generate passed" || { echo "❌ buf generate failed"; exit 1; }
task: status command command -v buf >/dev/null 2>&1 && buf --version | grep -Fqx "BASE-BUF_VERSION" exited non-zero: exit status 1

=== task: install ===
task: "_install:linux" not for current platform - ignored
task: "_install:macos" finished
task: "_install:macos" started
task: "_install:windows" not for current platform - ignored
task: "install" finished
task: "install" started
task: [_install:macos] brew install bufbuild/buf/buf
task: [_install:macos] echo 'Buf installed.'
task: [_install:macos] echo 'Installing Buf via Homebrew...'
task: status command command -v buf >/dev/null 2>&1 && buf --version | grep -Fqx "BASE-BUF_VERSION" exited non-zero: exit status 1

=== task: install:undo ===
task: "_install:undo:linux" not for current platform - ignored
task: "_install:undo:macos" finished
task: "_install:undo:macos" started
task: "_install:undo:windows" not for current platform - ignored
task: "install:undo" finished
task: "install:undo" started
task: [_install:undo:macos] brew uninstall bufbuild/buf/buf
task: [_install:undo:macos] echo 'Buf removed.'
task: [_install:undo:macos] echo 'Removing Buf via Homebrew...'
task: status command ! command -v buf >/dev/null 2>&1 exited non-zero: exit status 1

=== task: lint ===

    "$input" \
    BASE-EXTRA_ARGS
  "$input" \
  BASE-EXTRA_ARGS
  buf lint --config "BASE-CONFIG" \
  exit
  filter "SKIPFILES_PATTERN=$skip_pattern" SKIPFILES_MATCHING=true |
  find "$scan_input" -type f -name '*.proto' -print0
  printf '%s\000' "$scan_input"
  set -- "$@" --exclude-path "$path"
  tr '\0' '
' >"$matched_files"
buf lint "$@" --config "BASE-CONFIG" \
done <"$matched_files"
elif [ -f "$scan_input" ]; then
fi
fi | task --silent --taskfile "$REPO/taskfiles/buf/../internal/skipfiles/Taskfile.yml" \
if [ -d "$scan_input" ]; then
if [ -n "" ]; then scan_input=.; fi
if [ -z "$skip_pattern" ]; then
matched_files="$(mktemp)"
scan_input="$input"
set --
skip_pattern='BASE-BUF_LINT_SKIP_PATTERN'
task: "_buf:unix" finished
task: "_buf:unix" started
task: "_buf:windows" not for current platform - ignored
task: "_install:linux" not for current platform - ignored
task: "_install:macos" finished
task: "_install:macos" started
task: "_install:windows" not for current platform - ignored
task: "install" finished
task: "install" started
task: "lint" finished
task: "lint" started
task: [_buf:unix] input='BASE-INPUT'
task: [_install:macos] brew install bufbuild/buf/buf
task: [_install:macos] echo 'Buf installed.'
task: [_install:macos] echo 'Installing Buf via Homebrew...'
task: [lint] echo "✅ buf lint passed"
task: status command command -v buf >/dev/null 2>&1 && buf --version | grep -Fqx "BASE-BUF_VERSION" exited non-zero: exit status 1
trap 'rm -f "$matched_files"' EXIT
while IFS= read -r path; do

=== task: upgrade ===

  brew install bufbuild/buf/buf
  brew upgrade bufbuild/buf/buf
else
fi
task: "_upgrade:linux" not for current platform - ignored
task: "_upgrade:macos" finished
task: "_upgrade:macos" started
task: "_upgrade:windows" not for current platform - ignored
task: "upgrade" finished
task: "upgrade" started
task: [_upgrade:macos] echo 'Buf upgraded.'
task: [_upgrade:macos] echo 'Upgrading Buf via Homebrew...'
task: [_upgrade:macos] if brew list bufbuild/buf/buf >/dev/null 2>&1; then

=== task: version ===
task: "_install:linux" not for current platform - ignored
task: "_install:macos" finished
task: "_install:macos" started
task: "_install:windows" not for current platform - ignored
task: "install" finished
task: "install" started
task: "version" finished
task: "version" started
task: [_install:macos] brew install bufbuild/buf/buf
task: [_install:macos] echo 'Buf installed.'
task: [_install:macos] echo 'Installing Buf via Homebrew...'
task: [version] buf --version
task: status command command -v buf >/dev/null 2>&1 && buf --version | grep -Fqx "BASE-BUF_VERSION" exited non-zero: exit status 1
